# Redis: cluster info

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

When an autonomous agent needs to check Redis cluster health, it should look up the cluster info endpoint. The cluster info endpoint SOURCE FACT REQUIRED returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED status codes and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED response shapes. The cluster info endpoint provides SOURCE FACT REQUIRED fields for SOURCE FACT REQUIRED metrics such as SOURCE FACT REQUIRED memory usage and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED shard distribution.

Search intents:
